basics.name: Rohan Senan
basics.summary:
Mechanical Engineer with hands-on experience in design, testing, and validation of mechanical systems for real-world
applications. Proficient in CAD modeling, multi-level assemblies, engineering drawings, and BOM creation, with
experience supporting manufacturing, prototyping, and design iteration in laboratory and production environments. Proven
ability to collaborate cross-functionally, follow and execute work with urgency to meet project timelines. Passionate about
building robust, mechanical systems from concept through prototype and validation.

education.area: BS in Mechanical Engineering, minor in Computer Science
